scientific_integrity: Algebraic proof plus independent finite exact-integer checks; no independent mathematical audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats precisely four generators for m>=6; it does not classify larger odd-step truncations, representation counts, or full Ore semigroups. Published m=6 full-Ore Frobenius/genus data are credited. Indexed and primary-source comparisons do not establish global bibliographic uniqueness.
title: A five-class pseudo-Frobenius law for a four-generator numerical-semigroup family
